kql:
imFileEvent
| where FilePath contains "recycle bin"

imProcessCreate
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has "accepteula"
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has "-s"
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has "-r"
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has "-q"
| where ActingProcessName !endswith "sdelete.exe"

imProcessCreate
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has "accepteula"
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has "-s"
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has "-r"
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has "-q"
| where ActingProcessName !endswith "sdelete.exe"

imProcessCreate
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has "accepteula"
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has "-s"
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has "-r"
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has "-q"
| where ActingProcessName !endswith "sdelete.exe"

imProcessCreate
| where ActingProcessName == "net.exe"
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("user", "group")

imProcessCreate
| where CommandLine has "mailbox export"
| where CommandLine has "delete"
| summarize ExportAndDeletionCount = count(), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by ActorUsername, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

imProcessCreate
| summarize ProcessStartCount = count(), FirstSeenTime = min(ActingProcessCreationTime), LastSeenTime = max(ActingProcessCreationTime)    by ActingProcessName, bin(TimeGenerated, 3d)
| where ProcessStartCount <= 1

imProcessCreate
| where ActingProcessName == "rundll32"

imProcessCreate
| where ActingProcessName == "rundll32.exe"

imDns
| where DnsResponseCodeName == "NOERROR"
| summarize BeaconingCount = count(DnsQuery), QueriedDomains = make_set(DnsQuery, 100), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where BeaconingCount > 10
| project SrcIpAddr, BeaconingCount, QueriedDomains, EventStartTime, EventEndTime

imDns
| summarize QueryCount = count(), QueriedDomains = make_set(DnsQuery, 100), FirstQueryTime = min(TimeGenerated), LastQueryTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where QueryCount > 10

imDns
| where DnsResponseCodeName != "NOERROR"
| summarize NonNoerrorDnsCount = count(), DnsResponseCodes = make_set(DnsResponseCodeName, 25), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| project SrcIpAddr, NonNoerrorDnsCount, DnsResponseCodes, EventStartTime, EventEndTime

let Baseline = imNetworkSession
| where NetworkApplicationProtocol == "SMB"
| summarize BaselineAvg = avg(NetworkBytes)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 14d);
imNetworkSession
| where NetworkApplicationProtocol == "SMB"
| summarize CurrentAvg = avg(NetworkBytes)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| join kind=inner (Baseline) on SrcIpAddr
| where CurrentAvg > BaselineAvg + 50

imNetworkSession
| where NetworkApplicationProtocol == "dns"
| where DstPortNumber != 53

imWebSession
| where HttpStatusCode >= 500
| summarize ErrorCount = count(), ErrorCodes = make_set(HttpStatusCode, 100), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where ErrorCount > 1

imWebSession
| where HttpStatusCode >= 500
| summarize ErrorCount = count(), Urls = make_set(Url, 100), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where ErrorCount > 100

imWebSession
| where HttpStatusCode >= 500
| where HttpStatusCode < 600
| summarize ServerErrorCount = count(), Urls = make_set(Url, 100), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where ServerErrorCount > 100

imWebSession
| summarize DistinctUserAgentCount = dcount(HttpUserAgent), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated), UserAgents = make_set(HttpUserAgent, 100)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where DistinctUserAgentCount > 1

imWebSession
| summarize DistinctUserAgentCount = dcount(HttpUserAgent)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where DistinctUserAgentCount > 5

imWebSession
| where HttpStatusCode == 200
| summarize DistinctUserAgentCount = dcount(HttpUserAgent)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where DistinctUserAgentCount > 5

imWebSession
| where HttpStatusCode == 403
| summarize ForbiddenCount = count(), Urls = make_set(Url, 100), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| where ForbiddenCount > 100

imWebSession
| where HttpStatusCode == 403
| summarize ForbiddenCount = count(), Urls = make_set(Url, 100), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by SrcIpAddr, SrcUsername, SrcHostname, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| where ForbiddenCount > 100
